mapper.insert: insert into course_forum(course_id, writer_id, title, content) values(#{dto.courseId}, #{dto.writerId}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.content})
mapper.select: SELECT cf.id, cf.course_id, c.name AS courseName, cf.title, cf.content, cf.read_count, cf.created_at, cf.updated_at, u.id AS writerId, u.fullname AS writerName, u.type AS writerType, cf.is_hotpost FROM course_forum cf JOIN user u ON cf.writer_id = u.id JOIN course c ON cf.course_id = c.id WHERE cf.id = #{id} AND cf.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course_forum SET read_count = read_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE course_forum SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_forum_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.commenter_id, u.fullname AS commenterName, u.profile_img FROM course_forum_comment c JOIN user u ON c.commenter_id = u.id WHERE c.course_forum_id = #{forumId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_forum_comment (course_forum_id, commenter_id, content) VALUES (#{comment.courseForumId}, #{comment.commenterId}, #{comment.content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, commenter_id, content FROM course_forum_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course_forum_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_forum_like WHERE course_forum_id = #{forumId}
SELECT id, course_forum_id, user_id FROM course_forum_like WHERE course_forum_id = #{forumId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_forum SET forum_like = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_forum_like WHERE course_forum_id = #{forumId}) WHERE id = #{forumId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_forum_report (course_forum_id, user_id, report_detail, report_status) VALUES (#{report.courseForumId}, #{report.userId}, #{report.reportDetail}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM course_forum_comment WHERE course_forum_id = #{forumId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course_forum SET is_hotpost = TRUE, hotpost_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{forumId}
UPDATE course_forum SET is_hotpost = FALSE WHERE is_hotpost = TRUE AND hotpost_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_forum WHERE is_hotpost = TRUE

SELECT cf.id, cf.forum_like, cf.hotpost_at, IFNULL(cc.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount FROM course_forum cf LEFT JOIN (SELECT course_forum_id, COUNT(id) AS comment_count FROM course_forum_comment WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY course_forum_id) cc ON cf.id = cc.course_forum_id WHERE cf.is_hotpost = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE course_forum SET is_hotpost = FALSE, hotpost_at = NULL WHERE id = #{forumId}
